definitions.full: H7620. shabua שָׁבוּעַ noun masculine Dan 9:27 period of seven (days, years), heptad, week (on formation see Lag BN 67 ); — absolute ׳שׁ 9:27 (twice in verse); construct שְׁבֻעַ Gen 29:27-28 , dual שְׁבֻעַיִם Lev 12:5 ; plural שָֽׁבֻע(וֺ)ת Exod 34:22 4 t. Deuteronomy + (in technical term) 2Chr 8:13 ; late שָֽׁבֻעִים Dan 9:24 4 t. Daniel; construct שְׁבֻעֹת Jer 5:24 ( Ezek 45:21 read שִׁבְעַת with Vrss and all modern, see שֶׁבַע ); suffix שָׁבֻעֹתֵיבֶם Num 28:26 ; — 1 period of seven days (froma given time), week: Deut 16:9 (twice in verse); Lev 12:5 (P); of marriage feast Gen 29:27-28 , (E; compare Judg 14:12 ; Tob 11:19); יָמִים שָׁבֻעִים Dan 10:2-3 ,three weeks, days (three weeks long); ׳שׁ קָצִיר חֻקּוֺת Jer 5:24 weeks of statutes (i.e. weeks appointed by ׳י ) for harvest ; technical term שָֽׁבֻעֹת חַגּ Exod 34:22 (J) feast of weeks (ending seven weeks of harvest), Deut 16:10 , 16 ; 2Chr 8:13 so ׳שׁ alone Num 28:26 (P). 2 heptad or seven of years, late , Dan 9:24-25 , 26 , 27 (twice in verse). — שֻׁבֻעוֺת Ezek 21:28 see שָׁבַע ].
